About Me

Turning ideas
into visual stories

I'm a passionate Graphic Designer and Motion Graphics artist, currently pursuing my BA with a love for visual storytelling and bold, creative design. I've worked on freelance projects in branding, social media, and promotional design.

As a fresher, I bring fresh ideas, strong creative energy, and a keen eye for detail. Design for me is not just about making things look good — it's about solving problems and communicating ideas with clarity and impact.
